name: FreeMilk
tagline: Free on-device coding agent for iPhone — Swift/web apps with a daily model allowance

xSignals.text:
Introducing a free coding agent that runs locally on your iPhone - FreeMilk 

- Free daily allowance of coding models: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GPT 6 Luna, and GLM 5.3 Flash (will add more)

- Reads and writes files on-device with local git support

- GitHub integration to clone
